mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.created_at, m.role, m.attempt_no, m.status, m.content, m.blocks_json FROM agent_message m JOIN agent_conversation c ON c.enterprise_id = m.enterprise_id AND c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE m.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND m.conversation_id = #{conversation} AND c.user_id = #{user} AND c.status <> 'deleted' ORDER BY m.created_at, CASE WHEN m.role = 'user' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.attempt_no, m.id LIMIT #{limit}
